about_the_game:
A dark age has ended, but something sinister lingers. A mysterious infection is spreading, and you are not immune. As an aspiring alchemist, you must master the art of potion crafting—not just to turn a profit, but to save your own life. Explore a fractured world, experiment with powerful ingredients, and piece together lost knowledge to uncover the cure… before time runs out.

Explore and Gather Rare Ingredients

Venture into a world still scarred by darkness, where nature has reclaimed the ruins of old civilizations. Each region is tied to an elemental monolith, offering unique ingredients of varying quality. Some can be easily foraged, while others require careful extraction—or a willingness to take risks for something truly rare.

Experiment and Master Alchemy

There are no recipes, no shortcuts—only what you learn through trial and error. Combine ingredients, harness elemental essences, and use enchanted crystals to enhance your brews. Some potions are profitable, others are dangerous, and a rare few may hold the key to curing the infection that threatens you.

Run Your Own Potion Shop

Customers come with different personalities, needs, and budgets. Some seek simple remedies, others request powerful elixirs—some may even push for potions that defy the laws of alchemy. Manage your shop, optimize your brewing process, and shape your reputation through the potions you choose to sell… and to whom.

A Race Against Time

Gold and reputation mean little if you don’t survive. The infection spreads within you, and every potion you craft, every ingredient you discover, brings you one step closer to the truth. The cure exists—but no one will hand it to you. Will you be the one to uncover it, or will you succumb to the fate of alchemists before you?
